findings.title: 图片/视频总结缺少当前媒体有效性检查

findings.resolution: 删除事务采集实际最新镜头及全部所需媒体Blob，提交成功后返回；UI只用该快照注册恢复，最新成果与共享媒体/排序/失败回滚回归通过。

findings.title: 宽 patch 与严格槽位 API 的契约不同，存在绕过风险
db/lib 值循环与混合职责
repository 职责实际耦合，不能只按表拆文件
全表写事务扩大耦合与锁竞争
媒体逐条回收重复全库扫描
无调用的导出收窄（可选）
记忆候选请求并发导致正文与来源错配
findings.resolution: Parent synchronous shared candidate lock/owner/epoch across latest/history; frozen input/source/excerpt editor session; stale callbacks/completions and retired saved sessions cannot rebind or resubmit. Explicit latest-revision reconciliation unchanged.

findings.title: 工作记录/总结草稿的离开保护不完整
参数局部 patch 以旧完整快照写回
findings.resolution: Changed-field context patches merge transaction-latest policy; resets/default copies explicitly replace including absent tokens. ShotRow submits selected boolean membership intent applied to latest shot with owner/reference checks and caught errors; bulk/full-array replacement unchanged.

findings.title: 主题行截获子动作的键盘事件

findings.resolution: One thread/project compose scope owns text revision, references/import resources. Capture synchronously; transfer captured home payload only, guarded nav restore/retrylocation, acknowledge only submitted scope/version afterbegin; newtopic failure retainsdraft. Actual callbacks and nativebrowser reproduced former risk.

findings.title: 参数变化时旧查询和槽草稿的 target 未完整隔离
findings.resolution: Tag query identity including null/empty, key target lifecycle before query/state hooks, protect manual dirty/pending navigation and parent-driven material selection; preserve same-target frozen baseline and readable unavailable sessions. Independent check fixed cleanup/unmount bookkeeping and passed final19browser/66test evidence.

findings.title: 镜头/场次文本编辑的错误和草稿恢复协议分裂
异步剧本文件读取没有新旧请求和本地编辑保护
findings.resolution: Editor/operation ownership freezes credentials and guards success/error/nestedread/finally; synchronous writes block duplicate/dismissal/input/open. Script imports use latest request+editrevision; explicit conflict adoption/discard and useLatest retire old reads; actual callbacks confirm former risks.

findings.resolution: 未知供应商状态不进入finishReason；合法诊断保留，message完整脱敏后截断；真实run/message持久化回归通过。
